metadata.question: Is there an increase in corn, wheat, and soybean planting from 2003 to 2019 in the Great Plains grasslands, US?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use USDA/NASS Cropland Data Layer (USDA/NASS/CDL) to quantify crop-specific planted area for corn (code 1), soybeans (code 5), and wheat (codes 22,23,24) over the Great Plains (union of ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, MT, WY, CO, NM). Target years are 2003 and 2019. If 2003 data are unavailable in CDL (likely), fall back to earliest available nationwide year (2008) and analyze 2008–2019.
2. Masking strategy: CDL is a classification; no cloud masking needed. Use class masks to isolate each crop.
3. Logic: Check if 2003 collection is empty; if so, fall back to 2008–2019. Validate with pixel counts (counts > 0). If counts are zero after masking => C2. If any calculation returns null/NaN => C3. Determine increase by comparing 2008 vs 2019 and also compute linear trend (slope) for evidence. If all three crops increase => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States');
    const gpStates = ['North Dakota','South Dakota','Nebraska','Kansas','Oklahoma','Texas','Montana','Wyoming','Colorado','New Mexico'];
    const region = states.filter(ee.Filter.inList('NAME', gpStates)).geometry().dissolve();
    const scale = 1000;
    const endYear = 2019;
    const requestedStartYear = 2003;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const cdl = ee.ImageCollection('USDA/NASS/CDL');
    const cdl2003 = cdl.filterDate('2003-01-01', '2003-12-31');
    const cdl2019 = cdl.filterDate('2019-01-01', '2020-01-01');
    const size2003 = await cdl2003.size().getInfo();
    const size2019 = await cdl2019.size().getInfo();
    let startYear = requestedStartYear;
    if (size2003 === 0) {
      // Fallback to earliest nationwide CDL availability (2008).
      startYear = 2008;
    }
    const years = [];
    for (let y = startYear; y <= endYear; y++) years.push(y);
    if (years.length === 0) {
      console.log('No valid year range.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing helpers
    function getCDLImage(year) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('USDA/NASS/CDL')
        .filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(year,1,1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year+1,1,1))
        .first()
        .select('cropland');
    }
    function areaAndCount(img, codes) {
      const mask = codes.reduce((m, code) => m.or(img.eq(code)), ee.Image(0)).rename('mask');
      const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(mask);
      const countImg = ee.Image(1).updateMask(mask);
      const areaM2 = areaImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('area');
      const count = countImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('constant');
      return ee.Dictionary({area_km2: ee.Number(areaM2).divide(1e6), count: count});
    }
    function round(n, d=2) {
      if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return n;
      const p = Math.pow(10, d);
      return Math.round(n * p) / p;
    }

    // 4. Compute time series areas
    const cornCodes = [1];
    const soyCodes = [5];           // Note: excludes double-crop classes to avoid double counting
    const wheatCodes = [22,23,24];  // Durum, Spring, Winter wheat

    const cornSeries = [];
    const soySeries = [];
    const wheatSeries = [];
    let firstCounts = null;
    let lastCounts = null;

    for (const y of years) {
      const img = getCDLImage(y);
      const isNull = await ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(img, null).getInfo();
      if (isNull) {
        console.log(`CDL ${y}: 0 images`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      const cornDict = areaAndCount(img, cornCodes);
      const soyDict = areaAndCount(img, soyCodes);
      const wheatDict = areaAndCount(img, wheatCodes);

      const cornArea = await ee.Number(cornDict.get('area_km2')).getInfo();
      const soyArea = await ee.Number(soyDict.get('area_km2')).getInfo();
      const wheatArea = await ee.Number(wheatDict.get('area_km2')).getInfo();

      if ([cornArea, soyArea, wheatArea].some(v => v === null || isNaN(v))) {
        console.log('Calculation produced null/NaN.');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }

      cornSeries.push(cornArea);
      soySeries.push(soyArea);
      wheatSeries.push(wheatArea);

      if (y === years[0]) {
        firstCounts = {
          corn: await ee.Number(cornDict.get('count')).getInfo(),
          soy: await ee.Number(soyDict.get('count')).getInfo(),
          wheat: await ee.Number(wheatDict.get('count')).getInfo()
        };
      }
      if (y === years[years.length - 1]) {
        lastCounts = {
          corn: await ee.Number(cornDict.get('count')).getInfo(),
          soy: await ee.Number(soyDict.get('count')).getInfo(),
          wheat: await ee.Number(wheatDict.get('count')).getInfo()
        };
      }
    }

    // 5. Validation & Trend calculation
    const regionAreaKm2 = await ee.Number(
      ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('area')
    ).divide(1e6).getInfo();

    if (!lastCounts || [lastCounts.corn, lastCounts.soy, lastCounts.wheat].every(c => c === 0)) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking in end year.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    function slope(yearsArr, valuesArr) {
      const n = yearsArr.length;
      const xmean = yearsArr.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n;
      const ymean = valuesArr.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n;
      let num = 0, den = 0;
      for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
        const dx = yearsArr[i]-xmean;
        num += dx*(valuesArr[i]-ymean);
        den += dx*dx;
      }
      return num/den;
    }
    const xYears = years.slice(); // numeric array
    const cornSlope = slope(xYears, cornSeries);
    const soySlope = slope(xYears, soySeries);
    const wheatSlope = slope(xYears, wheatSeries);

    const cornInc = cornSeries[cornSeries.length-1] - cornSeries[0] > 0;
    const soyInc = soySeries[soySeries.length-1] - soySeries[0] > 0;
    const wheatInc = wheatSeries[wheatSeries.length-1] - wheatSeries[0] > 0;
    const allInc = cornInc && soyInc && wheatInc;

    // 6. Print concise evidence (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Region (Great Plains states) area km2: ${round(regionAreaKm2, 0)}`);
    console.log(`CDL 2003 images: ${size2003} -> using ${years[0]}–${endYear}`);
    console.log(`CDL 2019 images: ${size2019}`);
    console.log(`Scale used (m): ${scale}`);

    const y0 = years[0], y1 = years[years.length-1];
    console.log(`Corn km2: ${y0}=${round(cornSeries[0],0)}, ${y1}=${round(cornSeries[cornSeries.length-1],0)}, slope/yr=${round(cornSlope,1)}, px${y1}=${lastCounts.corn}`);
    console.log(`Wheat km2: ${y0}=${round(wheatSeries[0],0)}, ${y1}=${round(wheatSeries[wheatSeries.length-1],0)}, slope/yr=${round(wheatSlope,1)}, px${y1}=${lastCounts.wheat}`);
    console.log(`Soy km2: ${y0}=${round(soySeries[0],0)}, ${y1}=${round(soySeries[soySeries.length-1],0)}, slope/yr=${round(soySlope,1)}, px${y1}=${lastCounts.soy}`);
    console.log(`All three increased (${y0}-${y1})? ${allInc}`);

    // 7. Final Answer
    // Since 2003 CDL is unavailable nationwide, we used 2008–2019 as the best-available proxy.
    // If all increased -> A (Yes), else B (No)
    console.log(allInc ? 'A' : 'B');

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
